content:
U.S. Navy patent filed in 2016 for Triangle Craft using an inertial mass reduction device

#ufotwitter

It's 2018 U.S. Navy patent (inventor: Salvatore Pais) for a highly unconventional craft that claims to achieve propulsion by reducing its own inertial mass.

It's important to understand that US Navy Triangle uses these two patents for craft power generation:

-Electromagnetic field generator and method to generate an electromagnetic field
-High frequency gravitational wave generator

Those two patents are meant to be supporting subsystems for the craft, not separate unrelated tech.

Let’s connect them clearly 👇

🧩 The 3 patents as one system

All three are by the same inventor (Salvatore Pais) and were filed together as a stacked concept:

1. 🛸 Main vehicle
US10144532B2 → “Inertial mass reduction craft”
👉 This is the actual vehicle

2. ⚡ Power / field generator
US10135366B2 → Electromagnetic field generator
👉 This is basically the engine core
What it does:

Generates extremely high-energy electromagnetic fields

Uses piezoelectric materials + rapid vibration + charge buildup
This is the thing that creates the conditions needed for the “Pais effect”

3. 🌌 Advanced effect generator
US10322827B2 → High-frequency gravitational wave generator
👉 This is like an extension / amplification system
What it claims:

Converts EM energy into gravitational waves (spacetime disturbances)

Could be used for:

propulsion
communication through matter
extreme physics interactions

🔗 How they fit together (important)

Think of it as a 3-layer system:

Step 1 — Field generation
Electromagnetic Field Generator Patent
Creates ultra-high energy EM fields

⬇️

Step 2 — Vacuum interaction

Those fields interact with quantum vacuum
This is the core idea behind: inertia reduction
“bubble” around the craft

⬇️
Step 3 — Advanced effects (optional)
Gravitational Wave Generator Patent
Adds:

gravitational wave emission

potentially stronger spacetime manipulation
⬇️

Final result
Inertial Mass Reduction Craft
Uses all of the above to:
reduce inertia

achieve propulsion without propellant

🧠 Important insight (this is key)

These are NOT independent inventions.

They are meant to work together like:

EM generator (US10135366B2) → produces energy field
Gravitational wave generator (US10322827B2) → manipulates spacetime
Craft (US10144532B2) → uses both to move

👉 In other words:

The craft depends on those technologies to function.

Basically this is what we would call Field-Resonance propulsion which combines electromagnetic field with gravitational waves and it enables craft  intergalactic travel without prohibitive time scales.

NASA has Paper from 1979 titled Field Resonance Propulsion Concept.
